name: SegmentOCR
source: Derived from license-plate recognition; built on AUTOMATIC1111 WebUI v1.10.1, sd-webui-segment-anything, sd-webui-ocr (PP-OCRv4) and ESRGAN
workflow: ESRGAN upscale, SAM car check, plate segmentation, client-side crop, PP-OCRv4 OCR of a license plate.

upstream_code.name: sd-webui-segment-anything
upstream_code.license: none stated (no license file in the repository)

upstream_code.name: sd-webui-ocr
upstream_code.license: none stated (no license file in the repository)

server_patches.what: optional output_mode/mask_index fields on /sam/sam-predict (default: upstream response)

models.name: ESRGAN 4x (ESRGAN_4x)
models.license: not stated for the file; release asset of cszn/KAIR (MIT); ESRGAN project xinntao/ESRGAN (Apache-2.0)

models.name: GroundingDINO SwinT-OGC
models.note: run with the extension's bundled implementation (config.json sam_use_local_groundingdino=true); text encoder bert-base-uncased from the Hugging Face hub

datasets.name: OpenALPR benchmarks, endtoend/us
datasets.license: AGPL-3.0 (repository license; no separate image license stated)
datasets.derivation: PIL.ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(radius=1.0) on the RGB image, saved as PNG with Pillow 12.1.0

plate_prompts: plate (retry if the first returns no mask)

adaptations: inputs are OpenALPR photos with a Gaussian blur applied locally (the prototype used one blurred photo of unknown origin)
input taken from a manifest row instead of a fixed file path
request-ID headers and client-side request logging removed; request bodies unchanged
server patch 0001 adds the output_mode/mask_index fields this client sends; sd-webui-ocr patch sets the detection thresholds as deployed

development_hardware.server_gpu: NVIDIA A40 (46068 MiB visible), driver 595.71.05, torch 2.1.2+cu121
development_hardware.client: macOS laptop, Python 3.10.18, on a separate network over an SSH tunnel
